test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

She lived in __well-resourced__ surroundings.
solution:
The correct answer is **"luxurious".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Being well-resourced **means having all the **tools, funds, etc. needed to carry out one's duties.**
 
• Anything that is **luxury** will be of **very high quality or expensive taste.**
 
• The **underlined word** is the **adjective** that can be substituted by **"luxurious".**

**​Correct sentence: **She lived in luxurious__ surroundings.
